Listen for a wake phrase even when TOCO is closed. Uses noticeable battery and holds the microphone, so other apps may not be able to record.
Read answers aloud instead of only showing them.

Separate phrases with commas. Shorter phrases trigger more often by accident.
While the screen is locked TOCO can still change volume, toggle the flashlight, control media and answer out loud. Opening apps or dialling needs “Display over other apps”, because Android blocks background apps from starting screens.
If listening stops on its own, set TOCO to Unrestricted in your battery settings — the system killed the service.
I can only run device commands right now. Add a Gemini key to answer questions.
A key is compiled into this build, so TOCO can answer questions.
No key in this build. Add GEMINI_API_KEY as a GitHub repository secret, then rebuild. Device commands still work.

To make long-pressing home open TOCO: Settings → Apps → Default apps → Digital assistant app → TOCO.
Some phones put this under Settings → Additional settings → Gestures. TOCO must have microphone access first.
Will tell you about missed calls when you unlock
When you unlock your phone, TOCO tells you who called while you were away. Needs call log access. Long-press this row to test it.

TOCO speaks at ringtone loudness on the ring stream, so it is clear without turning media volume up. While TOCO talks the volume keys show Ring. If your phone is on silent, ring volume is 0 and TOCO will not be heard.
Show a floating card on your home screen after unlocking, with tap-to-call buttons. Needs Display over other apps.
